waypoints.name: Downey Creek Trailhead
waypoints.note: Corrected - previous waypoints incorrectly placed this route ~59 miles away at Amphitheater Mountain (Pasayten Wilderness), a research error. South Peak is actually part of the Gunsight Range, Glacier Peak Wilderness - same remote 2-day approach as Middle Peak (Downey/Bachelor Creek trail to Itswoot Ridge, Dome-Chickamin col, Chickamin Glacier).
waypoints.directions: From Darrington, drive SR 530 north about 8 miles to the Suiattle River Road (FS Road 26) and follow it east about 20 miles to the Downey Creek Trailhead at about 1,450 feet, just past the Downey Creek bridge; the trail leaves the north side of the road and parking is on the south side. A Northwest Forest Pass or interagency pass is required. The Suiattle River Road is prone to washout closures, so check its status first.

waypoints.name: South Peak (Gunsight Range)
waypoints.note: A real, distinct summit — the southernmost of four named summits (Northeast/North/Middle/South) along one short ridge crest, reached last in a north-to-south traverse after Middle Peak. This coordinate is a disclosed geometric estimate ~0.2mi south of Middle Peak's position (48.30571,-120.99439) along the ridge, not a directly measured fix.
waypoints.directions: Follow the Downey Creek Trail to the footlog over Bachelor Creek, then the unmaintained, brushy Bachelor Creek path to Cub Lake, over Itswoot Ridge and across glacier ground to the Dome-Chickamin col. Cross the Chickamin Glacier to the west side of the peak and stop directly beneath the summit; the West Face starts in the chimney on the left side of the face and climbs four pitches, finishing up the face and left to the summit.
